description: This Python source file handles reading and writing configuration settings for the BORIS application. It includes functions to load user preferences from a file, manage default values, and save updated preferences back to the configuration file. The code interacts with Qt's QSettings to persist settings and uses various modules and dialogs for user prompts and configuration management.

methods.name: read(self)
methods.description: Reads the BORIS configuration file from the user's home directory, loading various user preferences and settings. It handles missing files by prompting the user for first launch. The method updates the internal state of the object with the loaded settings.

methods.name: save(self, lastCheckForNewVersion=0)
methods.description: Saves the current configuration and preferences to the user's home directory. It writes various settings such as geometry, display preferences, and recent projects to persistent storage.
